# Commonplace fonts

Original families and styles from the Google Fonts CSS2 stylesheet already referenced by the HTML, retrieved over verified HTTPS. Only Latin WOFF2 subsets are retained; other scripts use the existing system fallbacks. Font CSS is in commonplace-fonts.css.

Courier Prime, DM Sans, Fraunces, JetBrains Mono, Literata, Newsreader, Plus Jakarta Sans, Space Grotesk, Syne, Work Sans.

Each family includes its SIL Open Font License from https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/.
